title: Beta berlayar jauh, the Moluccan marines' monument
check_note: Marineterrein news and the Stadscuratorium advice (12 May 2026) say only 'the Voorwerf'; not in the city art register (Nov 2026). Pin still an estimate.

title: Catharinahofje, Egelantiersgracht (former)
check_note: City panorama of 3 Jul 2025: nos. 203-213 have a run of stoops with basement doors under them; no marked alley entrance is visible. Whether the Vierhuizengang is open needs a look.

title: Cineac, Duiker's newsreel cinema
check_note: City panorama 19 Jun 2025: canopy and booth window intact, Merkur Casino under the canopy. Google Maps (Nov 2026) lists 'Cineac Amsterdam', a cultural association. Current use to confirm.

title: De Aardige Amsterdammer, a hand for the volunteers
check_note: Hand reported damaged May 2024. City panoramas of Jun and Jul 2025 along the Droogbak front of De Regenboog (no. 1A) and the square at the pin show no hand. Gone or moved?

title: De Naaister and the corn measure, Bergstraat
check_note: No street imagery inside the Bergstraat (city panorama has none since 2023). The pin is at Bergstraat 6; place the statue exactly on site.

title: De Swarte Mvele and the De Vries van Buuren building (Waterlooplein 3)
check_note: City panoramas Jan and 19 Jun 2025 do not show the stone; in June 2025 the corner building was in scaffolding. Pin still near the corner of Waterlooplein 3.

title: De Vorstenlanden, Eduard Huf's cigar shop in the Zoutsteeg
check_note: Still Kadinsky (own site, Nov 2026), as Café Zoutsteeg or 'Kadinsky Sessions' at no. 9. Which, and how legible the beam lettering is, needs a look.

title: Door wind bewogen beweging, Wicher Meursing's last wind sculpture
check_note: City panoramas of 16 Oct 2024 and 17 Jun 2025 show the vanes in different positions, so it turns; whether it swings freely is not known.

title: Elizabeth Wolffschool, a public school for paying girls
check_note: City panorama 16 Jun 2025: no school sign at no. 927; bell plates for 927, 927a and 927b suggest separate units. Current use still unknown.

title: Geldersekade 105 and the raid of 26 May 1943
check_note: Joods Monument (2024) dates the raid photo 25 or 26 May 1943; the couple died on 21 May, so it cannot show their arrest. Match the houses in the photo on site.

title: Hamer- en Bouwershofje, two old hofjes moved to the city's edge
check_note: Okura staff use also in nl.wikipedia and amsterdamopdekaart.nl, but no source dated after July 2018 (search 24 Nov 2026). Confirm on site.

title: Hoogte Kadijk, the old sea dike and its last shipyard
check_note: Udinck stone seen at Tussen Kadijken 13 (city panorama, 19 Jun 2025). De 3 Bloeyende Koorn Aaren not found on the fronts of Hoogte Kadijk 109-117 in the same imagery.

title: Kas-Associatie, two cashiers' banks and an elephant clock
check_note: Confirm the elephant clock, the Mercury statue and the De Distel tile panel are still in the hall now that it is The Duchess.

title: Kettner's piano shop, with its wares in tiles
check_note: Nespresso shop; the PIANO'S and ORGELS tile panels are there (city panorama, Jan 2025). The ridge railing cannot be seen from the narrow street; check from a distance.

title: Leprozenpoort and the Grenspaal: the lepers' gate that moved, and a turtle carrying city debris
check_note: Pin on the address point of Sint Antoniesluis 22; the gate stands on the front of nos. 21-24, check which spot.

title: Lifeboat shed on the Windroosplein
check_note: Newest imagery (city panorama, 19 Jun 2025, before the reopening) shows NOORD- & ZUID-HOLLANDSCHE REDDINGMAATSCHAPPIJ on the front; back wall and the state after the rebuild unchecked.

title: Lindengracht, the filled canal and the eel riot
check_note: The pin is on the Lindengracht; where exactly the Zaterdagse brug crossed, and so where the eel hung, is not settled.

title: Lokaal 't Loosje and its brewery tile wall
check_note: The horse-tram waiting room and the origin of the name rest on the café's own account; an archive photo or tram history would settle them.

title: Maison Stroucken, the party hall inside DeLaMar
check_note: City panorama of 14 Jul 2025 shows the old brick and sandstone fronts beside the glass, but neither the winged dog nor round stair turrets can be made out. Needs a look on site.

title: Nieuwezijds Kapel, the Holy Place inside a shopping block
check_note: en.wikipedia puts the chapel remains in the Enge Kapelsteeg, nl.wikipedia names both alleys. The city panorama has no images inside either alley since 2023. Settle on site.

title: Nieuwezijds Kolk, the castle under the street
check_note: No marker known; pin from the dig plan on the Kolk. Check on site for any sign in the paving.

title: Noordermarkt: the post, the plaque and the outline in the paving
check_note: The pin is on the Woutertje Pieterse statue (seen on its plinth, city panorama Jun 2025); a short post stands west of it but could not be confirmed as the water-tap post.

title: O Johnny, the gaper that replaced a gaper
check_note: Drugstore Het Heertje closed in spring 2024; the gaper was photographed in June 2024, and a blog post of 1 Sep 2026 shows it again. No dated authoritative source yet.

title: Odeon, from brewery to concert hall to gay disco
check_note: Supper Dining & Club runs the club-restaurant at no. 460 (Google Maps listing, open, Nov 2026). Still to check: whether the lamb is still on the gable.

title: Olieslagerssteeg, the lepers' house, the oil pressers and Maison de Bonneterie
check_note: 4en5mei.nl (Nov 2026) still puts the plaque in the stairwell of the Rokin store, now an H&M. Whether it is still there is not known.

title: Pakketpostgebouw, the parcel machine beside Centraal Station
check_note: Now Gebouw De Oost, still NS-owned; front restored to its original look (2024). What is inside (probably railway offices) is not confirmed.

title: Plukbos, the food forest behind the Wittenburg blocks
check_note: Pin on the garden in the inner court; which street gate is the main way in is not confirmed.

title: Prinseneiland: the last tar winch, the Palmentuin and Mandela's garden
check_note: City panorama of 17 Jun 2025 only covers the Galgenstraat: the walls by the Sloterdijkerbrug carry graffiti, no Mandela mural identified; the quay and winch cover are out of view.

title: Reestraat 6, where Anton de Kom lived
check_note: City panorama 16 Jun 2025: no De Kom plaque on the front of no. 6; one small two-line plate under the window box is unreadable. Check that plate.

title: Roetershofje, behind a door on the Lindengracht
check_note: City panorama 3 Jul 2025 shows ordinary house doors on the fronts round the pin and no marked hofje passage. Whether a court survives behind is unconfirmed.

title: Rozengracht bridges and the tram to Zandvoort
check_note: Bridge 167 was still a works site in the city panorama of 3 Jul 2025 (barriers, new paving); the stub of third rail cannot be picked out. 117 partly open since 26 Oct 2026 (AT5). Needs a look.

title: Sint Luciënsteeg, the gable stone wall
check_note: Works began 3 Sept 2026; NH Nieuws reports monumental parts boarded over. No street imagery after that (city panorama: none in the alley since 2023). Screening and exact pin still to check on site.

title: Swigtershofje
check_note: City panorama 19 Jun 2025: the carved gate shut, with an intercom, boarding and a scaffold tower above it. De Key ownership after 2018 and any opening not confirmed.

title: The Dam shooting of 7 May 1945 and its 32 name stones
check_note: Pin on the 4en5mei point for the stones; the 1947 plaque is on the corner of the Kalverstraat.

title: The Kogelbron, a granite ball floating on water
check_note: City panorama 19 Jun 2025 shows the ball still on its stone in the park. Whether the water runs and the ball turns cannot be seen; check on site.

title: The Russensjoel and the old "Jodenkerkstraat" (Nieuwe Kerkstraat 149)
check_note: Not among the synagogues listed by the NIHS, Amsterdam's Ashkenazi community (nihs.nl, Nov 2026); the latest service listing found is from 2004. Whether it still holds services is unconfirmed.

title: The bicycle garage under the water at Stationsplein
check_note: Pin on the garage itself; the spot of the Lex Horn walls inside is not known.

title: The first Tooneelschool building, Marnixstraat 150
check_note: City panorama 3 Jul 2025: building intact and in use, no name sign on the front. Studios confirmed only to 2023 and November 2025 listings.

title: The floating gardens of Robert Jasper Grootveld, Wittenburgervaart
check_note: The rafts lie near the Ezelsbrug, diagonally opposite the Bandenboot; pin approximate on the water. No street imagery shows that stretch of water (city panorama, Jan and Jun 2025).

title: The garden house that moved behind Keizersgracht 62
check_note: Stadsherstel (Nov 2026) gives the current user as Stichting Euro Business Center; no open-day opening of the garden house found. Pin approximate, behind the houses.

title: The harmonica player of the Anjeliersstraat, by a sculptor nobody names
check_note: City panorama of 3 Jul 2025 shows the player on no. 175 and the white figures on no. 82's balcony; the figure on the lamp cable could not be made out. Check that one on site.

title: The rooster of De Haan's matzo factory (Valkenburgerstraat)
check_note: Sources differ on where inside the stone hangs (the hall of the flats or the parking garage entrance) and whether it can be seen from outside

title: The stumbling threshold at the Artis tram stop (Plantage Middenlaan)
check_note: Pin moved to the Artis stop in front of the Hollandsche Schouwburg (city panorama, 19 Jun 2025). The threshold itself was not made out in the platform paving; exact spot still open.

title: Tip Top, the Jewish quarter's theatre (gone)
check_note: Pin placed on the old theatre site; set it on the stained-glass windows in the academy's front once seen

title: Tjerk Hiddesschool, the school children fought over and Constant's studio
check_note: City panorama of 19 Jun 2025: the street front at no. 3 has front doors with bells and letterboxes, and the playground wall with its gate stands beside it. Current use still unconfirmed.

title: Trompettersteeg, the narrowest alley and its hidden coat of arms
check_note: City panorama 16 Jun 2025: the alley entrance by no. 86 is covered with tags, stickers and a poster; neither the 3D arms nor the sailors can be made out. Check on site.

title: Tuin Bickersgracht Noordkop and children's farm De Dierencapel
check_note: The farm's wooden house and gate are at the pin (city panorama, 17 Jun 2025). The edge of the neighbours' garden beside the skate ramp is not visible from the street; check on site.

title: Volkskoffiehuis on the Kadijksplein
check_note: SOTTO closed May 2026; the newest street imagery (city panorama, Jun 2025) still shows SOTTO and no Volksbond name on the long wall. What opens there, and the name, need a look.

title: Walenweeshuis, the Walloon orphanage waiting for a future
check_note: Permit 19 Dec 2025 (Z2025-038483). Newest street imagery (city panorama 16 Jun 2025) shows site fencing along the Vijzelgracht front, no scaffolding. Start of works unconfirmed.

title: Walk of Pride, queer names from the Dam to the Homomonument
check_note: Pin at the Dam end of the Raadhuisstraat; fix it on Jillis Bruggeman's first tile. The city (video, July 2026) counts 52 tiles; the foundation says 'ruim 50'.

title: Walraven van Hall's snapped tree and the Navalny memorial, Frederiksplein
check_note: City panorama 14 Jul 2025 shows the bronze fallen tree on its curved wall. The painted acacia on the north side not yet seen in dated imagery after 2018.

title: Waterline, a red figure on the quay wall
check_note: Pin approximate; place the figure exactly and confirm it is still there. The newest street imagery (city panorama, Jun and Jul 2025) predates the work, which appeared late 2025.

title: Zeelandbank, a thank-you bench from Schouwen-Duiveland
check_note: Newest city panorama (29 Sep 2025) shows the park still behind building hoardings by the pancake pavilion; bench not visible. Exact spot in the redesigned park to confirm.

title: Zuid-Afrikahuis, the library whose books were thrown in the canal
check_note: City panorama of 16 Jun 2025: no eagle seen on the street front (fanlight with wheel tracery, carved door, hoist hood). Where the eagle is, and the reading room floor, need a visit.
